description.narrative:
Sverige kommer att stödja AJMTEM, en civil organisation från Moldavien, för genomförandet av kärnstödsaktiviteter försedda av AJMTEM Strategiska plan och RAF under 2020 – 2023. Kärnstöd beviljas för att stärka den institutionella kapaciteten och för att stödja genomförandet av AJMTEM medellång sikt Strategisk plan 2020—2023. Huvudmålet och det förväntade resultatet av kärnverksamheten är att AJMTEM bidrar till att utveckla journalisternas kapacitet att återspegla miljöfrågor.
Under den förberedande processen för insatsen, så har Sida’s principer och centrala prioriteringar för samarbetet med civilsamhällesorganisationer diskuterats med partnern. AJMTEM ställer sig bakom Sidas gemensamma utgångspunkter för samarbete. Ambassaden tillsammans med AJMTEM kommer att ha en kontinuerlig, öppen och transparent dialog om etiska och andra värdebaserade frågor.

Sweden will support AJMTEM, a civil society organisation from Moldova, to implement core support activities provided by AJMTEM Strategic Plan and RAF during 2020 - 2023.
Core support is granted to strengthen institutional capacities and to assist the implementation of AJMTEM medium term Strategic Plan 2020-2023. The main objective and expected result of core activities is that AJMTEM contributes to developing the capacities of journalists in reflecting environmental issues.
Principal values for Sida and cooperation partners were shared and discussed as guidance during initial consultations on the contribution/project between programme coordinator and organization. AJMTEM is open to endorse Sida's common starting points for cooperation. The Embassy, together with AJMTEM will have a continuous, open and transparent dialogue on ethical and other value based issues.

The main objective of the Core support to AJMTEM is the institutional development of the association and the shift from project-based towards a mission-driven orgaization. In this way, the within the core support, AJMTEM will implement its strategy for the period 2020-2023 and the coresponding Results Assessment Framework. The major outcomes that AJMTEM is working towards are: - Consolidation of environmental journalism;- Increased environmental awareness of population achieved through an adequate environmental information;- A well developed and sustainable organization; During the implementation period it is expected a number of active journalists to regularly publish informative, analytical and investigative materials on environment and climate related topics, in a well informed and objective manner. It is expected, this to contribute to a better understanding of environmental issues by the public and its active participation in environmental decision making.

During the period of receiving a Sida Core-support, the Association has worked a lot on institutional development of organisation following the implementation of its strategy for the period of 2020-2023 and the corresponding Results Assessment Framework. Also, AJMTEM has worked towards increasing the environmental awareness of population by organising wide communication campaigns and posts on different platform about environmental crimes, events, workshops, visits, working with students and kids, etc. In 2022, AJMTEM in partnership with Moldovan State University was launched for the first time a course of Environmental Journalism for students and in 2023 is gonna be run the second edition of this course.
The results achieved during the 2023 - April 2024 period: AJMTEM focused its efforts on informing and educating the public about environmental issues, employing diverse methods such as social media campaigns, workshops, and public events to reach as many people as possible. In 2023, over 2,496,973 people were informed about environmental topics, nearly double the number from 2022.
Progress toward Final Result 1: Enhanced promotion and strengthening of environmental journalism
- Training and Development of Journalists' Skills: AJMTEM conducted a series of training sessions and expert meetings, which significantly contributed to improving journalists' competencies.
- Establishment of the Environmental Journalism Course at the State University of Moldova (USM). In the 2023-2024 academic year, 21 students enrolled, with 12 successfully completing the course. This demonstrates the course's effectiveness in enhancing student interest and skills in the field.
- Internship Program for Young Journalists at AJMTEM. In 2022, two students completed internships, and by 2023, the numbergrew to eight. Among them, two students were hired by Ecopresa, while two others chose thesis topics focused on environmental issues.
- Environmental Journalism Awards. The competition highlights the improvement in journalists' skills in covering environmental issues. The number of entries rose to 62 in 2023, compared to 60 in 2022 and 38 in 2021.
Progress toward Final Result 2: Increased Public Awareness and Sensitization to Environmental Issues
- The number of individuals informed, engaged, and actively applying their knowledge in environmental protection has significantly increased due to AJMTEM's informational campaigns and activities. In 2023 alone, over 2,496,973 people were reached and educated on environmental issuesnearly double the number from 2022.
- Ecologic Economic Information Campaign: Launched in 2022 in response to the energy crisis in the Republic of Moldova, this campaign has continued through 2023 and 2024.
- "Stories from the ECOmunity" Campaign: Launched in 2022 and concluding in 2023, this campaign featured a series of seven video stories branded by Ecopresa, designed to showcase how a passion for environmental protection can lead to a fulfilling life.
- Campaigns joined by AJMTEM: AJMTEM has been actively involved in key environmental initiatives, including the "July Without Plastic" and "World Cleanup Day" campaigns in 2023.
- Thematic discussions and trainings: In 2023 and 2024, AJMTEM further expanded its impact by organizing and taking part in thematic discussions and training sessions for youth and community representatives. These initiatives targeted a wide range of environmental topics, such as energy efficiency, green economy, environmental journalism, and communication. Over the course of these years, AJMTEM conducted 10 meetings, engaging 464 young people from various educational institutions across Moldova. - Eco Camp (2023). In 2023, AJMTEM hosted the first edition of Eco Camp, an immersive nature experience aimed at adults, families, and nature lovers.
Progress toward Final Result 3: An Organization with Enhanced Efficiency, Professionalism, and Sustainability, Recognized for its Environmental Expertise at the National Level
From 2021 to 2024, AJMTEM has seen major growth thanks to support from the Swedish Embassy. Highlights include:
1. Enhanced journalist engagement at key meetings.
2. Boosted visibility and collaborations with notable organizations.
3. Strengthened team and governance, ensuring a solid working environment.
4. Strategic growth, helping them navigate crises like COVID-19.
5. Improved internal processes and increased funding through new partnerships.
In short, AJMTEM has built a sturdy foundation to tackle environmental issues while expanding their influence and operations.
- Organizational Development: In 2023 and 2024, AJMTEM benefited from organizational development coaching provided by an expert from Ukraine. This process included mapping development directions, identifying self-financing opportunities, evaluating existing resources, and creating an action plan. Professional Development: To improve their professional competencies, the AJMTEM team participated in a series of training sessions on various topics, ranging from environmental issues to communication, management, and governance. Participation in round tables and thematic workshops allowed the team, including reporters, project assistants, and development directors, to deepen their knowledge in solid waste management, wastewater treatment, recycling, energy efficiency, and monitoring projects funded by European Union resources.
Ecopresa Anniversary - 10 Years: In 2023, Ecopresa celebrated 10 years of activity. AJMTEM organized an anniversary event, inviting the environmental community, the journalistic sector, collaborators, and strategic partners.
Increase in Quality and Quantity of Materials: Thanks to the expanded team, the Ecopresa editorial team produced more high-quality materials and diverse content on social media platforms. In 2023, Ecopresa achieved an impressive impact with 117,943,177 views across the Ecopresa website, TikTok channel, Instagram, and Facebook.
The audience of AJMTEM's platforms responded positively and actively to the informative materials produced by the team. Videos featuring Dominte and Profir, included in the "Ecological, Economic" campaign, generated particular interest and were widely shared.
Ecopresa Statistics: • Website ecopresa.md: 173,977 unique readers in 2023, representing a 79% increase compared to 2021. • Facebook Page: Over 1.2 million users in 2023, a 200% increase compared to 2021. • TikTok: Hiring a content creator resulted in 23,600 followers, with videos surpassing 1 million views. The channel gathered over 115.9 million views from 2023 to April 2024.
AJMTEM applies the principles of good governance in its organizational activities, utilizing strategic documents and internal policies, including from cross-cutting perspectives, and a revised organizational chart that clearly defines the roles of the external Management Board, General Assembly, and staff.
In 2023, AJMTEM continued to develop partnerships with NGOs and economic agents, signing partnership agreements during Environment Day. The earmarked amount for supporting AJMTEM's activities doubled compared to 2021.
Since the core support funding concluded in May 2024, here is the summary from the independent auditor regarding the extent to which AJMTEM's objectives have been achieved: As noted in the audit report, AJMTEM has implemented eight of the nine remaining recommendations on the area of financial management. We deem the organization has made commendable progress by the development and revision of templates, procedures and policies, also the implementation of training for the Censor, and the execution of audits. These measures are all deemed important for the internal control systems.
The fundraising strategy provided illustrates a variety of methods to diversify income sources, such as different types of services, which is a positive step towards financial sustainability. However, the strategy's activities are described in general terms and lack specific timelines or designated responsible individuals for revaluation. The organization could develop their strategical approach by ensuring appropriate procedures to analyse successful and non-successful fundraising approaches. The insights should be used to optimise future strategies.
At the same time, the auditor has highlighted a number of recommendations and areas of improvement which should be considered by the organization to further strengthen the systems and routines. Auditor perceived the representatives at AJMTEM seemed eager and willing to implement the recommendations presented in the different sections, in order to further strengthen its internal control systems and grants management systems.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
